messages:
Maria Chen: Routing-bot alert: sudden spike of EU customer requests routed to us-east model variants, 8x baseline, started ~1898765400. logs show repeated variant reassignments for same session IDs. 😬
Ava (routing-bot): [alert] region_mismatch_count=820, variant_switches=620, top_tenant=acme-inc, tier=premium
Jonas Patel: copying a sample from the decision logs: `req=R-9f3a route_decision: prefer=eu-west, fallback=us-east-quant, switch_count=4, last_switch_ts=1898765461`
Samir Lopez: that `switch_count=4` is the red flag. looks like we keep flipping between variants when telemetry shows intermittent latency spikes. pinging @Lina for oncall visibility.
Lina (sre-oncall): saw the alert. looking at infra: no region outage. latency spikes are transient (~200-600ms bursts) from the eu-west pool then recover. policy code seems to retry with lower-cost variant which happens to be us-east so cross-region hop occurs.
Maria Chen: this creates two bad effects: 1) extra tail latency for the user, 2) variant-switch churn that amplifies load across regions. we should stop cross-region fallback for premium for now. short mitigation suggestion: add `region_affinity=0.95` for premium and a variant-switch cooldown of 120s.
Jonas Patel: agreed. quick fix we can push via the routing FF: `routing.cooldown_v1` -> set cooldown_ms=120000 and `routing.enforce_region_affinity=true` for tiers=[premium,enterprise].
Samir Lopez: also add a soft circuit: if variant_switch_rate > 0.05 (5%) for a tenant in 5m window, quarantine variant switching for that tenant for 10m. prevents oscillation.
Priya (data-eng): we need telemetry first: please add a metric `routing.variant_switch_rate` with tags {tenant,region,model_variant,tier}. I can templatize the Grafana panel.
Maria Chen: minimal rollout plan: canary FF to 1% (safest), monitor variant_switch_rate and cross_region_rps for 10m, then 10%, then 100%. put auto-rollback if variant_switch_rate increases >2x baseline.
Jonas Patel: I'll prepare a small PR to policy-service. snippet of change:
```
- fallback_policy: { allow_cross_region: true, cooldown_ms: 0 }
+ fallback_policy: { allow_cross_region: false_if_tier_premium, cooldown_ms: 120000 }
```
I'll attach feature flag gating.
Lina (sre-oncall): while PR is merging, can we push an emergency rule to lb-router: `no-cross-region-for-tenant: acme-inc`? That will stop the biggest noisy tenant.
Samir Lopez: yes we have a per-tenant override table. applying now. command: `curl -X POST https://infra-api/local-overrides -d '{"tenant":"acme-inc","policy":"no_cross_region"}'`
Ava (routing-bot): override applied for tenant=acme-inc by Samir Lopez at 1898765480
Priya (data-eng): added metric `routing.variant_switch_rate` to metrics pipeline with low-cardinality tags, pushed a dashboard draft: /dashboards/routing/variant_oscillation. Panel: time series + top-20 tenants by switch rate.
Maria Chen: followups: 1) PR for cooldown and affinity (Jonas) 2) quarantine circuit implementation (Samir) 3) FF rollout + runbook (Maria) 4) dashboard + alert (Priya) 5) customer comms ops if needed (ops lead)
Jonas Patel: PR up: https://git/repo/policy-service/pulls/402 diff includes unit tests and FF flag. request review from @Samir and @Priya.
Samir Lopez: reviewing. question: do we also want to prefer model-quantized variants only if latency benefit > 50ms, to avoid tiny gains triggering switches?
Maria Chen: yes make threshold configurable. add `min_latency_improvement_ms` default 50.
Lina (sre-oncall): monitoring notes: set temporary alert `cross_region_rps > 50 for 2m` and `variant_switch_rate > 0.02 for any tenant` to page SRE during rollout.
Priya (data-eng): alerts configured and tested in staging. created an alert runbook pointing to the new dashboard and the FF kill switch.
Samir Lopez: after deploy, we should run a synthetic load test simulating 1000 premium sessions with intermittent eu-west latency spikes to validate cooldown. I'll schedule in load-env.
Maria Chen: thanks team. I'll own coordination and post status in #product-incidents. tagging follow-ups in the backlog. :thumbsup:
Ava (routing-bot): incident closed? pending: policy PR merged + FF at 10% + 10m observation period.
Maria Chen: closing this thread when FF at 100% or rollback executed.
